# CHIERO Inc.

> In business. In creation. Led by curiosity.

Updated September 8, 2026. CHIERO is based in Fukuoka, Japan. Its current activities are business advisory, media, publishing, and art and product development with AI.

## Company and founder

- Name: CHIERO Inc. / 株式会社CHIERO
- Representative Director: Ko Nakata / 中田 光, known as CHIERO
- Established: December 2020
- Address: Cercle Imaizumi 404, 1-3-23 Imaizumi, Chuo-ku, Fukuoka, Japan
- Company: https://chiero.jp/en/about/
- General and art inquiries: info@chiero.jp
- Press and publishing: press@chiero.jp
- Business advisory: work@chiero.jp / https://work.chiero.jp/ (Japanese service)

CHIERO’s philosophy is to explore the possibilities of this life with the world: take part in business, creation and everyday life, make and share value, and leave room for rest, care and discoveries. Ko researched IT and medicine at Kyushu University’s graduate school, became a professional street performer in Fukuoka, Tokyo and Sydney, worked in IT, then founded CHIERO. His practice connects wide reading, classical questions, the newest AI tools, making, publishing and observing the response.

## Art and applications

- TOKOYO: https://chiero.jp/tokoyo/en/ — Interactive mathematical art. Living forms appear from relationships between points. Reduce the points and the shape disappears while the formula continues. Officially selected for O-FEST 2026 in Moscow. Selection is not an award.
- Hodoku (ほどく): https://hodoku.chiero.jp/ — Released. Japanese AI journal for writing about work, relationships and feelings, then revisiting entries. First 7 entries free; paid options are explained on the app. Not a human counseling or medical service.
- Sonosaki (その先の声): https://sonosaki.chiero.jp/ — Released. Describe a desired scene, review and edit a script, then turn it into Japanese AI-generated affirmation audio. First audio track free. Uses provided synthetic voices, not a clone of the user’s voice; does not guarantee goals will be achieved.
- Relationship Atlas (関係図鑑): Released Japanese app. Answer six questions to create a free card without registration. Turn experiences and feelings into an editable digital book and letter with PDF saving. Books start at ¥980 including tax. https://zukan.chiero.jp/
- Bousaicle: https://chiero.jp/bousaicle/ — Free Japanese app for household emergency supplies and rotating stock. Supply data stays on the user’s device.
- 47 Prefectures, Interviewed: https://chiero.jp/en/interviews/ — Japanese-language Threads stories that imagine places as people. Blank entries have no published link. The series title does not imply all 47 stories are complete.
- Books: https://chiero.jp/en/books/ — More than 200 Japanese Kindle titles, from philosophy and Eastern thought to practical AI. Catalog: https://www.amazon.co.jp/stores/author/B0DQGV7F8D

## Business advisory

Conversations with business owners to untangle concerns, explore options and decide what comes next. Current scope, fees and conditions: https://work.chiero.jp/ (Japanese). Initial consultation: 90 minutes online, ¥50,000 including tax. Do not infer advisory outcomes from follower or view counts.

## Public records and the scope of figures

- Combined social followers: 400,000+, approximate September 2026 figures. Instagram 280,000; TikTok 40,000; YouTube 70,000; Threads 30,000; X 2,000. Includes cross-platform overlap, not unique individuals.
- Cumulative social video views: over 1 billion as reported by CHIERO across multiple operated accounts; not the counter of one post.
- Threads: 10,723,259 account-wide views, sum of 30 consecutive daily values retrieved from Threads Insights API on September 7, 2026. Not unique people or the prefecture series alone. Source: https://chiero.jp/media/threads-metrics-20260907.json
- Shin R25 interview, April 29, 2023: https://r25.jp/companies/mosh/interview/893013182472257536 — Sponsored content from MOSH. The founder describes services and results from that period.
- YouTube conversation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c7xsuyiRcrg — The title’s annual revenue above ¥100 million refers to the host’s business.
- Nippon TV’s The! Tetsuwan! DASH!!: filmed octopus footage supplied and credited on screen. Broadcast image: https://chiero.jp/en/press/#television
- TOKOYO’s O-FEST 2026 official selection: https://note.com/kounkt/n/n444551e25d02
- More than 200 Kindle titles. Hagakure introductory book previously reached Amazon bestseller #1 in the History & Geography Reference / White Papers category, as reported by CHIERO. Not a claim about current ranking or the whole Amazon store.
- Global Shapers Community Alumni; Ishibashi Scholarship Foundation council member since May 2026; completed the University of Tokyo’s AI Business Insights 2026.

## Free resources and following the work

Resources are in Japanese: https://chiero.jp/en/free/
- Seven-day, 24-page product workbook: https://work.chiero.jp/workbook/ — Preview selected pages; full PDF delivered after name and email registration. Adding official LINE afterward is optional.
- Five-question business worksheet: https://work.chiero.jp/worksheet/ — Free, no registration, processed on the device without saving or sending entries.
- Three writing prompts: https://hodoku.chiero.jp/tools/three-lines — Free, no registration, no AI; entries are not stored or sent. Copy to keep them.
